title: Hot Spicy Malaysian Pistachio Satay
description: A spicy and adventurous Malaysian dish featuring unsalted pistachio, this plant-based friendly satay is perfect for those looking for a springy texture and bold flavors. It is made with brine-dry and plant-based ingredients.
instructions: Soak the bamboo skewers in water for at least 30 minutes before using.
In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, lime juice, olive oil, ginger, garlic, sambal oelek, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Add the chopped pistachio to the blender and blend until well combined.
Thread the pistachio mixture onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the satay on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and cook the satay for 5-7 minutes per side, or until lightly charred.
Serve the satay hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
Garnish with additional chopped pistachio and sliced lime, if desired.
